messages.content: ramesh le 45 rupiya ko 3 wata kalam ra 120 rupiya ko 2 wata copy kinyo. usle 500 ko note diyo bhane kati firta paunchha?
ramesh le 125 rupiya firta paunchha.
euta bus pahila 3 ghanta 60 km/h ma gayo, ani 2 ghanta 40 km/h ma. jamma kati km gayo hola?
bus jamma 260 km gayo.
messages.steps: pahilo bhag: 60 x 3 = 180 km. dosro bhag: 40 x 2 = 80 km. jamma: 180 + 80 = 260 km.

messages.content: sita 12 barsha ki chhin. usko buwa usko bhanda 3 guna jetho hunuhunchha. 5 barsha pachhi buwa ko umer kati hunchha?
5 barsha pachhi buwa 41 barsha ko hunuhunchha.
messages.steps: ahile buwa: 12 x 3 = 36 barsha. 5 barsha pachhi: 36 + 5 = 41 barsha.

messages.content: hari ra gita le 1200 rupiya 2:3 ko anupat ma bandne. kasle kati paunchha?
hari le 480 rupiya ra gita le 720 rupiya paunchhan.
jutta ko mol 2400 ho, 25% discount chha. kati tirne?
discount pachhi 1800 rupiya tirnu parchha.
bank ma 50000 rupiya 8% barshik sadharan byaj ma 3 barsha rakhe bhane jamma kati hunchha?
3 barsha pachhi jamma 62000 rupiya hunchha.
aama le bajar bata 2 kg 500 gram aalu ra 750 gram pyaj lyaunubhayo. jamma kati gram bhayo?
jamma 3250 gram, arthat 3 kg 250 gram bhayo.
messages.steps: 2 kg 500 gram = 2500 gram. 2500 + 750 = 3250 gram = 3 kg 250 gram.

messages.content: school bihana 9:40 ma suru bhayera diuso 2:15 ma sakinchha. kati samaya padhai hunchha?
school 4 ghanta 35 minet chalchha.
messages.steps: 9:40 bata 10:00 samma 20 minet. 10:00 bata 2:00 samma 4 ghanta. 2:00 bata 2:15 samma 15 minet. 20 + 15 = 35 minet, jamma 4 ghanta 35 minet.

messages.content: mero kaksha ma 32 jana chhan. sir le 5 packet chakleti lyaunubhayo, har packet ma 18 wata. 23 wata bandisakiyo bhane kati baki chha?
67 wata chakleti baki chha.
messages.steps: jamma chakleti: 5 x 18 = 90. baki: 90 - 23 = 67. kaksha ma 32 jana bhanne kura yo prashna ko lagi chahindaina.

messages.content: Anita buys 3 kg of apples at Rs 180 per kg and 2 litres of milk at Rs 95 per litre. She pays with a 1000 rupee note. How much change does she get?
Anita gets Rs 270 back.
euta momo plate 35 rupiya ho. 4 plate ko kati?
4 plate momo ko 140 rupiya parchha.
ani 2 jana sathi thapiye, sabai lai ek ek plate. aba 300 diye kati firta?
aba 6 plate bhayo, 300 diye 90 rupiya firta aauchha.
messages.steps: pahila 4 plate thiyo, 2 thapda 4 + 2 = 6 plate. 6 x 35 = 210. firta: 300 - 210 = 90.

messages.content: kathmandu bata euta thau 180 km tadha chha. gadi 45 km prati ghanta ma kudyo bhane kati ghanta lagchha?
4 ghanta lagchha.
messages.steps: samaya = duri / gati = 180 / 45 = 4 ghanta. jaach: 45 x 4 = 180, milyo.

messages.content: bhai 9 barsha ko ra didi 15 barsha ki. 3 barsha pachhi didi ko umer bhai ko bhanda kati le dherai hunchha?
3 barsha pachhi pani didi bhai bhanda 6 barsha jethi hunchhin.
messages.steps: ahile farak: 15 - 9 = 6. 3 barsha pachhi didi 18, bhai 12, farak 18 - 12 = 6. umer ko farak kahile badalidaina.

messages.content: 20000 rupiya 10% sadharan byaj ma 2 barsha rakhda byaj kati aauchha?
2 barsha ma 4000 rupiya byaj aauchha.
5 barsha rakheko bhaye ni?
5 barsha rakheko bhaye 10000 rupiya byaj aauthyo, jamma 30000.
messages.steps: sadharan byaj samaya sanga sidha badhchha: 20000 x 10 x 5 / 100 = 10000. jamma: 20000 + 10000 = 30000.

messages.content: 100 wata suntala 7 jana sathi lai baraabar baadne ho. ek jana le kati paunchha ra kati baki rahanchha?
har jana le 14 wata paunchha, 2 wata baki rahanchha.
ma ghar bata school 3 km 450 m hidchhu. jaane aaune garda din ma kati meter hidchhu?
tapai din ma 6900 meter hidnu hunchha, arthat 6 km 900 m.
jacket 1500 ko, pahila 20% chhut, ani member card le baki mol ma arko 10% chhut. last ma kati tirne?
last ma 1080 rupiya tirnu parchha.
messages.steps: pahilo chhut: 1500 x 20 / 100 = 300, baki 1500 - 300 = 1200. dosro chhut: 1200 x 10 / 100 = 120, baki 1200 - 120 = 1080. dhyan dinus, yo 30% chhut barabar haina.

messages.content: bus bihana 8:50 ma chhutyo ra yatra 2 ghanta 15 minet ko chha. kati baje pugchha?
bus bihana 11:05 ma pugchha.
dipak 14 barsha ko ho. usle 25 rupiya ko 12 wata ande kinyo ra 60 rupiya ko euta paau roti. jamma kharcha kati?
dipak ko jamma kharcha 360 rupiya bhayo.
messages.steps: ande: 12 x 25 = 300. roti: 60. jamma: 300 + 60 = 360. umer 14 barsha le hisab ma farak pardaina.

messages.content: kaksha ma 45 jana chhan, keta ra keti ko anupat 4:5 chha. keta kati jana?
kaksha ma 20 jana keta chhan.
ani keti?
keti 25 jana chhan.
5 jana naya keta aaye bhane aba anupat k hunchha?
aba keta 25 ra keti 25, anupat 1:1 hunchha.
euta machine le 6 minet ma 24 wata botal bharchha. 16 minet ma kati botal bharchha?
16 minet ma 64 wata botal bharchha.
messages.steps: 1 minet ma: 24 / 6 = 4 botal. 16 minet ma: 4 x 16 = 64.

messages.content: rina ko 3 test ko ausat 72 chha. 4 test pachhi ausat 75 banauna chautho test ma kati lyaunu parchha?
chautho test ma 84 lyaunu parchha.
messages.steps: 3 test ko jamma: 3 x 72 = 216. 4 test ma chahine jamma: 4 x 75 = 300. chautho: 300 - 216 = 84. jaach: (216 + 84) / 4 = 75, milyo.

messages.content: A cyclist rides at 12 km/h. How long will it take to cover 30 km? (my sister is also cycling at 10 km/h but ignore her)
It takes 2 hours 30 minutes.
messages.steps: Time = 30 / 12 = 2.5 hours = 2 hours 30 minutes. Check: 12 x 2.5 = 30.

messages.content: pasale le 600 ma ek joda chappal kinera 750 ma bechyo. kati nafa bhayo ra kati pratishat?
150 rupiya nafa bhayo, jun 25% ho.
ma din ma 90 minet padhchhu. 5 din ma kati ghanta bhayo?
5 din ma 7 ghanta 30 minet bhayo.
messages.steps: 90 x 5 = 450 minet. 450 / 60 = 7 baki 30, arthat 7 ghanta 30 minet.

messages.content: 10 ghanta pugna ajha kati minet chahinchha?
10 ghanta pugna ajha 150 minet, arthat 2 ghanta 30 minet chahinchha.
paani tanki ma 1500 litre aatchha. pipe le minet ma 50 litre halchha. khali tanki bharna kati minet?
tanki bharna 30 minet lagchha.
3 daju bhai le 5000 rupiya bandne, tara jetho le pahila 800 badhi line. jetho le kati paunchha?
jetho le 2200 rupiya paunchha, aru dui le 1400 1400.
500 ml ko tel 210 ma, 1 litre ko 450 ma paincha. kun sasto?
500 ml ko packet sasto chha.
messages.steps: 1 litre = 1000 ml = 2 x 500 ml. 500 ml ko dui packet: 210 x 2 = 420. 420 < 450, tyasaile sano packet sasto, litre ma 30 rupiya bachchha.

messages.content: 2 jana ko umer ko jod 50 xa, farak 6 xa. thulo ko umer kati ho??
thulo ko umer 28 barsha ra sano ko 22 barsha.
mero talab 35000 ho, 20% bachaune plan chha. mahina ma kati bachchha?
mahina ma 7000 rupiya bachchha.
ek barsha ma ni?
ek barsha ma 84000 rupiya bachchha.
laptop 100000 ko chha, kati mahina lagchha kinna?
laptop kinna 15 mahina lagchha.
messages.steps: 100000 / 7000 = 14.28..., 14 mahina ma 98000 matra hunchha, tyasaile 15 mahina chahinchha. 15 mahina ma 105000 hunchha.

messages.content: 2 wata gadi 300 km tadha bata ek arka tira aaudai chhan, ek 70 km/h ra arko 80 km/h. kati samaya ma bhetchhan?
dui gadi 2 ghanta ma bhetchhan.
messages.steps: najik aaune gati: 70 + 80 = 150 km/h. samaya: 300 / 150 = 2 ghanta. jaach: 70 x 2 + 80 x 2 = 140 + 160 = 300, milyo.

messages.content: ghar ma 25 kg chamal chha. din ma 500 gram khanchhaun. kati din pugchha?
25 kg chamal 50 din pugchha.
exam ma 650 purnanka thiyo, maile 520 lyaye. sathi le 480 lyayo. mero pratishat kati?
tapai ko 80% aayo.
messages.steps: 520 / 650 x 100 = 80%. jaach: 650 x 80 / 100 = 520, milyo. sathi ko 480 tapai ko prashna ma chahindaina.

messages.content: ahile beluka 7:20 bhayo. 2 ghanta 35 minet agadi kati bajeko thiyo?
2 ghanta 35 minet agadi diuso 4:45 bajeko thiyo.
A taxi charges Rs 45 per km. How much for an 8 km ride?
An 8 km ride costs Rs 360.
and if we go 2 km further?
Then it is 10 km in total, so Rs 450.
kisan sanga kukhura ra bakhra gari 20 wata janawar chhan, jamma khutta 56. bakhra kati?
8 wata bakhra ra 12 wata kukhura chhan.
messages.steps: sabai kukhura bhaye 20 x 2 = 40 khutta. badhi khutta: 56 - 40 = 16. har bakhra le 2 khutta badhi dinchha: 16 / 2 = 8 bakhra. kukhura: 20 - 8 = 12. jaach: 12 x 2 + 8 x 4 = 24 + 32 = 56, milyo.

messages.content: prakash sanga 1800 rupiya thiyo. 1/3 kitab ma kharcha garyo, baki ko 1/4 khana ma. aba kati baki?
aba 900 rupiya baki chha.
3 dozen kera kineko, 7 wata pakeko thiyena faliyo. kati khana milchha?
29 wata kera khana milchha.
pokhara 240 km chha bhane 60 km/h ma kati samaya?
60 km/h ma 4 ghanta lagchha.
80 km/h ma kudaye kati samaya bachchha?
80 km/h ma 3 ghanta lagchha, tyasaile 1 ghanta bachchha.
mahina ma 120 unit bijuli khapat bhayo, ek unit 12 rupiya ani 100 rupiya service charge. bill kati aauchha? hamro ghar ma 5 jana chhaun.
bill 1540 rupiya aauchha.
messages.steps: unit ko mol: 120 x 12 = 1440. service charge thapda: 1440 + 100 = 1540. ghar ma kati jana bhanne kura le bill badaldaina.

messages.content: aama ko umer chhora ko 4 guna chha. chhora 10 barsha ko. aama kati ko?
aama 40 barsha ko hunuhunchha.
kati barsha pachhi aama chhora ko dui guna hunuhunchha?
20 barsha pachhi aama chhora ko dui guna hunuhunchha.
messages.steps: farak sadhai 40 - 10 = 30. dui guna huda aama = 2 x chhora, ani farak = chhora ko umer = 30. chhora 30 huna 30 - 10 = 20 barsha. jaach: 20 barsha pachhi chhora 30, aama 60, 60 = 2 x 30, milyo.
